## Overview

This week, we will focus on the Unix shell, TBA

## Learning goals & lectures

You will learn to use Unix shell commands to:

##### [**Working with files in the Unix shell I: The shell as a file browser**](./w3a_shellfiles.qmd) _(Tuesday)_

- Create, copy, move, rename and delete directories and files

##### [**Working with files in the Unix shell II: Viewing, summarizing and manipulating files**](./w3b_shellfiles.qmd) _(Thursday)_

- View the contents of text files in various ways
- Search within, manipulate, and extract information from text files

## Readings
